name: smwmusic-lollypop-amiga-underground
title: Lollypop (Amiga) - Underground
description:
Underground from Lollypop on the Amiga. Useful for dark environments, like caves or ghost houses.

This port was based off of the Amiga version, but I decided to spruce the port up a bit by applying some SNES echo and giving the delayed voices their own channels.
